title: Bunny OS encrypted sync envelope
description: What the sync service stores and routes. The envelope carries no plaintext description of the object and no key material, so an operator holding every envelope cannot read a single object. There is deliberately no field for a title, filename, tag, preview, mime type, wrapped key, or passphrase.

algorithm.description: Reviewed AEAD constructions only. Bunny OS does not define its own primitive.

collectionId.description: Opaque to the service. The service is not told which collection holds memories.

objectVersion.description: Monotonic per object. Bound as associated data so a service cannot replay an older version as current.

nonce.description: Base64. Length is checked against the algorithm: 24 bytes for XChaCha20-Poly1305, 12 for AES-256-GCM.
